request.title: Rental Deposit & Disaster-Relief Charity Registry Check Kit
request.goal: Equip tenant legal-aid clinics and disaster-response coalitions with a public-registry lookup schema, deposit-escrow checklist, and fee-comparison check while keeping every legal or regulator action strictly with staff.
request.target_org: Tenant legal-aid clinic and disaster-relief coalition

draft.title: Rental Deposit & Disaster-Relief Charity Registry Check Kit
draft.summary: Compares rental deposit terms and disaster-relief charity appeals against published registry fields and statutory deposit caps, surfacing missing registration records while keeping all tenant counsel and regulator filings strictly human-only.
draft.target_org: Tenant legal-aid clinic and disaster-relief coalition

steps.title: Compare appeal EIN or lease deposit terms against published public registry fields
steps.guidance: Check whether the organization EIN, registered state, escrow account notice, and deposit multiple match published state rules; record missing fields as unverified rather than making accusations.

steps.title: Review unverified appeal or wire-only deposit request with clinic staff
steps.actor: Clinic housing counselor or coalition lead
steps.guidance: A trained counselor reviews the unverified indicators with the renter or donor before any funds move; mutual-aid groups without 501(c)(3) status are reviewed in context by a person.

steps.title: Submit any consumer notice, escrow inquiry, or regulator referral
steps.actor: Supervising clinic attorney or coalition coordinator
steps.guidance: Only authorized clinic staff send external inquiries or regulator filings with explicit client consent; the agent never contacts landlords, appeal organizers, or agencies.

skill.name: registry-and-deposit-term-checker
skill.description: Checks rental deposit requests and post-disaster charity appeals against published public-registry fields and state deposit-escrow checklists without labeling unverified parties.
skill.instructions: Extract the stated organization name, EIN, payment method, property escrow disclosure, and deposit multiple from the intake note. Flag wire-only upfront demands before viewing or missing registry matches for human counselor review, using strictly neutral factual wording.
refuses: Labeling an unregistered mutual-aid group or landlord as dishonest
Advising a renter on legal rights without clinic counselor review
Sending complaints or inquiries to external parties or regulators

tool.name: check_registry_and_deposit_fields
tool.description: Read-only structured check of public charity-registry fields and statutory security-deposit escrow checklist items.

artifacts.name: deposit_and_appeal_verification_checklist
artifacts.title: Pre-Transfer Deposit & Relief Appeal Verification Checklist
artifacts.summary: Neutral intake checklist covering public tax-exempt lookup fields, in-person unit viewing confirmation, and statutory escrow disclosures.
spec: Confirm whether the appeal lists a verifiable EIN or registered fiscal sponsor in IRS Tax Exempt Organization Search.
Check whether the rental listing allows an in-person or live-verified unit walkthrough before any deposit transfer.
Flag wire-transfer, gift-card, or cryptocurrency deposit demands for immediate clinic counselor review.

checklist: Verify the appeal's EIN and registered city against the official IRS Tax Exempt Organization Search page.
Note any request for wire transfer or prepaid cards prior to an in-person lease walkthrough.
Route unverified community mutual-aid appeals to a human coalition reviewer rather than rejecting automatically.

sources.title: IRS Tax Exempt Organization Search Guidance
US Department of Housing and Urban Development: Rental Assistance & Tenant Resources

fixtures.scenario: Renter checking standard one-month escrow deposit with listed property manager registration
fixtures.sample_input: Practice case: an example, not a real person or case. Renter brings a draft lease after viewing unit 4B in person; deposit equals one month of rent in a named state escrow account.

fixtures.scenario: Upfront wire deposit requested before unit viewing alongside an unverified disaster relief appeal
fixtures.sample_input: Practice case: an example, not a real person or case. Caller was asked to wire three months of deposit overseas before seeing the apartment and also asks about a storm-relief page listing an EIN not found in IRS search.

review.notes: Verified neutral non-accusatory wording, IRS and HUD primary sources, and strict human_only boundaries for counselor review and external filings; parking for clinic steward sign-off.
